title: Meta expands its AI-powered "Your Algorithm" feature from Instagram to Facebook and Facebook Reels and says it is using LLMs more in its ranking systems (Stevie Bonifield/The Verge)
summary: Stevie Bonifield / The Verge: Meta expands its AI-powered “Your Algorithm” feature from Instagram to Facebook and Facebook Reels and says it is using LLMs more in its ranking systems — Meta's bringing Instagram's “Your Algorithm” feature to Facebook, and using LLMs more to rank content.
contentText:
Stevie Bonifield / The Verge :

Meta expands its AI-powered “Your Algorithm” feature from Instagram to Facebook and Facebook Reels and says it is using LLMs more in its ranking systems   —  Meta's bringing Instagram's “Your Algorithm” feature to Facebook, and using LLMs more to rank content.﻿
